label: Evidence Strength
description: How strong the supporting Evidence is for an Evidence Claim, independent of the claim's type (association/contribution/attribution/causation) -- a causation claim and an association claim can each be backed by strong or weak evidence.

values.label: Anecdotal
values.definition: Based on isolated stories or individual accounts, not a systematic review.

values.label: Limited
values.definition: Based on a small or narrow body of evidence with significant gaps.

values.label: Moderate
values.definition: Based on a reasonably systematic body of evidence with some limitations.

values.label: Strong
values.definition: Based on a rigorous, systematic body of evidence with few limitations.

values.label: Inconclusive
values.definition: The available evidence does not clearly support or refute the claim.
